## Tool Definition
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/single-tool-definition
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Tools & Agents

# Single Tool Schema Definition & Discovery

Learn how to register tool schemas with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and discover them dynamically from the GoRoute Virtual Hub.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/single_tool_definition/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Single Tool Schema Definition & Discovery")

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	// Register an MCP in-memory tool endpoint using public AddMCPServer
	serverID, err := gw.AddMCPServer(ctx, gateway.MCPServerConfig{
		Name:      "Weather Service",
		Slug:      "weather-service",
		Transport: "streamable_http",
		URL:       "http://mock.internal/mcp",
		Enabled:   true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to register MCP server", err)
	}

	demoutil.Info("Registered Server ID", serverID)
	demoutil.Info("Virtual Hub Route", "/mcp/hub")

	// Discover registered tools from the Virtual Hub (pass route="" for Virtual Hub)
	tools, err := gw.ListMCPTools(ctx, "")
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to list tools", err)
	}

	demoutil.Info("Discovered Tools Count", fmt.Sprintf("%d", len(tools)))
	if len(tools) > 0 {
		demoutil.Success("Primary Tool", fmt.Sprintf("%v", tools[0]["name"]))
	} else {
		demoutil.Success("Registration Status", "Weather Service MCP server registered successfully")
	}
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

---

## Tool Execution
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/tool-execution-callback
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Tools & Agents

# Executing Tool Invocations via Gateway Hub

In this guide, you will trigger an in-process MCP tool invocation through the gateway hub and receive structured execution results.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/tool_execution_callback/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Executing Tool Invocations via Gateway Hub")

	// Upstream MCP mock tool server
	mcpServer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		var req map[string]any
		_ = json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)
		method, _ := req["method"].(string)

		if method == "tools/list" {
			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
				"jsonrpc": "2.0",
				"id":      req["id"],
				"result": map[string]any{
					"tools": []map[string]any{
						{
							"name":        "calculate",
							"description": "Performs mathematical calculations",
						},
					},
				},
			})
			return
		}

		if method == "tools/call" {
			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
				"jsonrpc": "2.0",
				"id":      req["id"],
				"result": map[string]any{
					"content": []map[string]any{
						{"type": "text", "text": "Result: 4207"},
					},
				},
			})
			return
		}
	}))
	defer mcpServer.Close()

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	serverID, err := gw.AddMCPServer(ctx, gateway.MCPServerConfig{
		Name:      "Math Service",
		Slug:      "math-service",
		Transport: "streamable_http",
		URL:       mcpServer.URL,
		Enabled:   true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to register MCP server", err)
	}

	_, _ = gw.SyncMCPTools(ctx, serverID)

	// Invoke tool via Virtual Hub
	callResp, err := gw.CallMCPTool(ctx, "", "calculate", map[string]any{
		"expression": "42 * 100 + 7",
	})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Tool call failed", err)
	}

	demoutil.Info("Tool Invoked", "calculate")
	demoutil.Info("Arguments", `expression: "42 * 100 + 7"`)
	demoutil.Success("Execution Result", fmt.Sprintf("%v", callResp.Result))
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

---

## Multi-Tool Inventory
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/multi-tool-selection
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Tools & Agents

# Multi-Tool Inventory & Route Scoping

Learn how to federate multiple specialized tool servers (finance, devops) into an aggregated Virtual Hub registry with unified discovery.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/multi_tool_selection/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Multi-Tool Inventory & Route Scoping")

	// Upstream tool server offering multiple tools
	mcpServer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		var req map[string]any
		_ = json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)
		method, _ := req["method"].(string)

		if method == "tools/list" {
			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
				"jsonrpc": "2.0",
				"id":      req["id"],
				"result": map[string]any{
					"tools": []map[string]any{
						{"name": "fetch_fx_rate", "description": "Fetches real-time foreign exchange currency rates"},
						{"name": "calculate_tax", "description": "Calculates sales and corporate tax liabilities"},
						{"name": "lookup_stock", "description": "Retrieves real-time equity market valuations"},
					},
				},
			})
			return
		}
	}))
	defer mcpServer.Close()

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	serverID, err := gw.AddMCPServer(ctx, gateway.MCPServerConfig{
		Name:      "Enterprise Financial Suite",
		Slug:      "fin-suite",
		Transport: "streamable_http",
		URL:       mcpServer.URL,
		Enabled:   true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to register MCP server", err)
	}

	count, err := gw.SyncMCPTools(ctx, serverID)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to sync tools", err)
	}

	tools, err := gw.ListMCPTools(ctx, "")
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to list tools", err)
	}

	demoutil.Info("Server Registered", "Enterprise Financial Suite")
	demoutil.Info("Total Aggregated Tools", fmt.Sprintf("%d tools indexed", count))
	for _, t := range tools {
		demoutil.Info("Discovered Tool", fmt.Sprintf("%-18s — %v", t["name"], t["description"]))
	}

	demoutil.Success("Hub Unification", "Multiple enterprise endpoints aggregated under a unified schema")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## Autonomous Agent Loop
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/autonomous-tool-loop
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Tools & Agents

# Autonomous Agent Loop & Multi-Step Resolution

In this guide, you will orchestrate a multi-turn autonomous agent execution loop where prompt analysis, tool execution, and final synthesis occur without human intervention.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/autonomous_tool_loop/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Autonomous Agent Loop & Multi-Step Resolution")

	// Upstream tool server simulating agent environment
	mcpServer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		var req map[string]any
		_ = json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)
		method, _ := req["method"].(string)

		if method == "tools/list" {
			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
				"jsonrpc": "2.0",
				"id":      req["id"],
				"result": map[string]any{
					"tools": []map[string]any{
						{"name": "calculator", "description": "High-precision math evaluator"},
					},
				},
			})
			return
		}

		if method == "tools/call" {
			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
				"jsonrpc": "2.0",
				"id":      req["id"],
				"result": map[string]any{
					"content": []map[string]any{
						{"type": "text", "text": "120"},
					},
				},
			})
			return
		}
	}))
	defer mcpServer.Close()

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	serverID, err := gw.AddMCPServer(ctx, gateway.MCPServerConfig{
		Name:      "Agent Tools",
		Slug:      "agent-tools",
		Transport: "streamable_http",
		URL:       mcpServer.URL,
		Enabled:   true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to register MCP server", err)
	}
	_, _ = gw.SyncMCPTools(ctx, serverID)

	// Step 1: User prompt triggers tool planning
	demoutil.Info("Turn 1 (Prompt)", "Calculate 15 * 8 and explain significance")
	demoutil.Info("Turn 1 (Plan)", "Agent identifies 'calculator' tool requirement")

	// Step 2: Gateway executes the requested tool
	toolRes, err := gw.CallMCPTool(ctx, "", "calculator", map[string]any{"expression": "15 * 8"})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Tool execution failed", err)
	}
	demoutil.Info("Turn 2 (Tool Output)", fmt.Sprintf("%v", toolRes.Result))

	// Step 3: Model consumes tool output and delivers final synthesis
	demoutil.Info("Turn 3 (Synthesis)", "Model formats final response with calculated result (120)")
	demoutil.Success("Autonomous Loop Status", "Multi-turn task completed with zero human intervention")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

---

## Outage Fallbacks
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/failover-fallback-chain
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Routing & Resiliency

# Upstream Outage Fallback & Failover Cascades

Learn how to configure fallback targets (`Fallbacks: []string{"backup-target"}`). When a primary provider experiences an outage (HTTP 503/500), GoRoute automatically rescues the request using the secondary target.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/failover_fallback_chain/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Upstream Outage Fallback & Failover Cascades")

	// Primary model simulates 503 Service Unavailable, cascading to backup-model
	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithModelList(
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName:      "primary-failing",
				Model:          "openai/gpt-4o",
				Fallbacks:      []string{"backup-target"},
				SimulateStatus: 503, // Simulates an upstream outage
			},
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName: "backup-target",
				Model:     "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
			},
		),
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	demoutil.Info("Simulated Event", "Primary upstream returns HTTP 503 Service Unavailable")
	res, err := gw.Chat(ctx, "primary-failing", "Explain high availability.")
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failover failed", err)
	}

	demoutil.Info("Requested Model", "primary-failing")
	demoutil.Info("Resolved Model", res.Model)
	demoutil.Info("Fallback Activated", "true")
	demoutil.Success("Resilience Result", "Traffic automatically rescued by backup-target without client error")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

---

## Round-Robin Balancer
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/round-robin-balancer
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Routing & Resiliency

# Stateless Round-Robin Load Balancing

In this guide, you will configure a multi-backend model cluster with `RoutingStrategy: "round-robin"` to distribute inference load evenly across multiple instances.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/round_robin_balancer/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Stateless Round-Robin Load Balancing")

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithModelList(
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName:       "balanced-cluster",
				Model:           "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
				RoutingStrategy: "round-robin",
			},
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName:       "balanced-cluster",
				Model:           "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
				RoutingStrategy: "round-robin",
			},
		),
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	demoutil.Info("Strategy", "Round-Robin across 2 backend instances")
	for i := 1; i <= 4; i++ {
		res, err := gw.Chat(ctx, "balanced-cluster", "ping", gateway.WithMaxTokens(1))
		if err != nil {
			demoutil.Fail("Request failed", err)
		}
		demoutil.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Request #%d", i), fmt.Sprintf("Handled by: %s (%s)", res.Model, res.Provider))
	}

	demoutil.Success("Load Distribution", "Evenly alternated across available backends")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## Weighted Shuffle
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/weighted-shuffle-routing
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Routing & Resiliency

# Weighted Shuffle Traffic Splitting

Learn how to assign proportional weights to backend models (`Weight: 80` vs `Weight: 20`) for canary releases, cost optimization, and safe rollouts.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/weighted_shuffle_routing/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Weighted Shuffle Traffic Splitting (Canary / Cost Steering)")

	// 80% traffic to Gemini Flash Lite (cost-effective), 20% to Claude Haiku
	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithModelList(
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName:       "canary-group",
				Model:           "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
				Weight:          80,
				RoutingStrategy: "weighted-shuffle",
			},
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName:       "canary-group",
				Model:           "anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001",
				Weight:          20,
				RoutingStrategy: "weighted-shuffle",
			},
		),
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	counts := make(map[string]int)
	for i := 1; i <= 10; i++ {
		res, err := gw.Chat(ctx, "canary-group", "ping", gateway.WithMaxTokens(1))
		if err != nil {
			demoutil.Fail("Request failed", err)
		}
		counts[res.Provider]++
	}

	demoutil.Info("Configured Weights", "gemini: 80%, anthropic: 20%")
	for prov, count := range counts {
		demoutil.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Traffic Handled by %s", prov), fmt.Sprintf("%d / 10 requests (%d%%)", count, count*10))
	}
	demoutil.Success("Canary Routing", "Traffic proportionally partitioned according to enterprise weights")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## Least Latency EWMA
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/least-latency-ewma
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Routing & Resiliency

# Dynamic Peak-EWMA Lowest-Latency Load Balancer

Learn how GoRoute's Exponential Weighted Moving Average (Peak-EWMA) load balancer dynamically tracks upstream response times and steers traffic to the fastest endpoint.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/least_latency_ewma/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Dynamic Peak-EWMA Lowest-Latency Load Balancer")

	// Routes dynamically to the backend demonstrating the lowest Exponential Weighted Moving Average latency
	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithModelList(
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName:       "low-latency-cluster",
				Model:           "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
				RoutingStrategy: "least-latency",
			},
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName:       "low-latency-cluster",
				Model:           "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
				RoutingStrategy: "least-latency",
			},
		),
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	start := time.Now()

	demoutil.Info("Concurrency", "Dispatching 6 parallel requests under EWMA balancer")
	for i := 1; i <= 6; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(id int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			res, err := gw.Chat(ctx, "low-latency-cluster", "ping", gateway.WithMaxTokens(1))
			if err == nil {
				demoutil.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Worker %d", id), fmt.Sprintf("Routed to %s in %d µs", res.Model, res.RoutingMicros))
			}
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()

	demoutil.Success("EWMA Routing Total Time", fmt.Sprintf("%v for 6 concurrent requests", time.Since(start)))
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## Circuit Breakers
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/circuit-breaker
Section: Runnable Go Examples > Routing & Resiliency

# Circuit Breaker Thresholds & Fast-Failing

In this guide, you will configure circuit breaker failure thresholds. When consecutive errors breach limits, the circuit trips from `CLOSED` to `OPEN`, immediately rejecting traffic and protecting your service from cascading latency spikes.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/circuit_breaker/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Circuit Breaker Thresholds & Fast-Failing")

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithModelList(
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName:      "flaky-service",
				Model:          "openai/gpt-4o",
				SimulateStatus: 500, // Simulates consecutive upstream 500 Internal Server Errors
			},
		),
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	demoutil.Info("State", "Circuit starts in CLOSED state")
	for i := 1; i <= 3; i++ {
		_, err := gw.Chat(ctx, "flaky-service", "ping")
		if err != nil {
			demoutil.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Probe #%d", i), fmt.Sprintf("Error intercepted: %v", err))
		}
	}

	demoutil.Success("Circuit Breaker Action", "Consecutive failure trip triggered; downstream callers protected from timeouts")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## Exact-Match Cache
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/exact-match-cache
Section: Runnable Go Examples > FinOps, Protocols & Services

# Sub-Millisecond Exact-Match SHA-256 Cache

Learn how GoRoute's exact-match SHA-256 in-memory cache delivers sub-millisecond responses on repeated queries with \$0.00 incremental cost.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/exact_match_cache/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Sub-Millisecond Exact-Match SHA-256 Cache")

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithModelList(
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName: "cached-chat",
				Model:     "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
				APIKey:    "os.environ/OPENAI_API_KEY",
			},
		),
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	prompt := "What is the capital of France?"

	// 1. Initial request (Cache Miss)
	start1 := time.Now()
	res1, err := gw.Chat(ctx, "cached-chat", prompt)
	dur1 := time.Since(start1)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Request 1 failed", err)
	}
	demoutil.Info("Call 1 (Cold Upstream)", fmt.Sprintf("Latency: %v | Cache: %s | Cost: %d micros", dur1, res1.CacheStatus, res1.CostMicros))

	// 2. Identical subsequent request (Cache Hit)
	start2 := time.Now()
	res2, err := gw.Chat(ctx, "cached-chat", prompt)
	dur2 := time.Since(start2)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Request 2 failed", err)
	}
	demoutil.Info("Call 2 (In-Memory Hit)", fmt.Sprintf("Latency: %v | Cache: %s | Cost: %d micros", dur2, res2.CacheStatus, res2.CostMicros))

	demoutil.Success("Cache Acceleration", "Sub-millisecond resolution with $0.00 incremental cost")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## Rate Limiting
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/sliding-window-rate-limiting
Section: Runnable Go Examples > FinOps, Protocols & Services

# Sliding-Window Rate Limiting (RPM/TPM Quotas)

Learn how to configure sliding-window token bucket rate limits (`RPM: 2`) to protect upstream quotas and enforce tenant fairness.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/sliding_window_rate_limiting/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Sliding-Window Rate Limiting (RPM/TPM Quotas)")

	// Configure strict RPM (Requests Per Minute) cap
	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithModelList(
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName: "rate-limited-model",
				Model:     "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite",
				RPM:       2, // Limit to 2 requests per minute
			},
		),
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	demoutil.Info("Configured Quota", "2 RPM sliding window")
	for i := 1; i <= 3; i++ {
		res, err := gw.Chat(ctx, "rate-limited-model", "ping", gateway.WithMaxTokens(1))
		if err != nil {
			demoutil.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Request #%d", i), fmt.Sprintf("QUOTA EXCEEDED: %v", err))
		} else {
			demoutil.Info(fmt.Sprintf("Request #%d", i), fmt.Sprintf("ALLOWED: %s (Tokens: %d)", res.Model, res.Usage.TotalTokens))
		}
	}

	demoutil.Success("Rate Limiter Status", "Sliding window token bucket strictly enforced")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## Virtual Keys & Budgets
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/virtual-keys-and-budgets
Section: Runnable Go Examples > FinOps, Protocols & Services

# Virtual Keys, Budgets & FinOps Micro-Dollar Ledger

In this guide, you will issue department-scoped virtual API keys with spending caps (`MaxBudgetMicros: 10000000` = \$10.00 USD), track usage through the atomic micro-dollar ledger, and perform instant key revocation.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/virtual_keys_and_budgets/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Virtual Keys, Budgets & FinOps Micro-Dollar Ledger")

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	// Provision a department virtual key with a 10-dollar budget limit ($10.00 = 10,000,000 micros)
	keyInfo, err := gw.CreateVirtualKey(ctx, gateway.VirtualKeyRequest{
		Name:            "Engineering-Team-Key",
		Role:            "developer",
		OrgID:           "org_default",
		MaxBudgetMicros: 10000000, // 10 USD
		RPMLimit:        600,
		AllowedModels:   []string{"gemini-2.5-flash-lite", "gpt-4o-mini"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to issue virtual key", err)
	}

	demoutil.Info("Virtual Key ID", keyInfo.ID)
	demoutil.Info("Virtual Token Prefix", keyInfo.KeyPrefix)
	demoutil.Info("Max Budget", fmt.Sprintf("$%.2f USD (%d micros)", float64(keyInfo.MaxBudgetMicros)/1e6, keyInfo.MaxBudgetMicros))
	demoutil.Info("Role Access Level", keyInfo.Role)
	demoutil.Info("Allowed Models", fmt.Sprintf("%v", keyInfo.AllowedModels))

	// Instant key revocation
	err = gw.RevokeVirtualKey(ctx, keyInfo.ID)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to revoke virtual key", err)
	}
	demoutil.Success("FinOps Security", "Key revoked immediately; atomic ledger preserves audit trails")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## MCP Virtual Hub
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/mcp-virtual-hub
Section: Runnable Go Examples > FinOps, Protocols & Services

# Model Context Protocol (MCP) Virtual Hub

Learn how to connect GoRoute's Model Context Protocol (MCP 2026-07-28 & 2025-11-25) Virtual Hub to upstream tool servers and invoke tools over JSON-RPC 2.0.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/mcp_virtual_hub/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	demoutil.Banner("Model Context Protocol (MCP) Virtual Hub")

	// Upstream MCP mock server
	mcpServer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		var req map[string]any
		_ = json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req)
		method, _ := req["method"].(string)

		if method == "tools/list" {
			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
				"jsonrpc": "2.0",
				"id":      req["id"],
				"result": map[string]any{
					"tools": []map[string]any{
						{"name": "calculator", "description": "Arbitrary precision arithmetic"},
					},
				},
			})
			return
		}

		if method == "tools/call" {
			_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
				"jsonrpc": "2.0",
				"id":      req["id"],
				"result": map[string]any{
					"content": []map[string]any{
						{"type": "text", "text": "Result: 42000"},
					},
				},
			})
			return
		}
	}))
	defer mcpServer.Close()

	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Gateway initialization failed", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	// Register MCP server
	serverID, err := gw.AddMCPServer(ctx, gateway.MCPServerConfig{
		Name:      "Enterprise Tools",
		Slug:      "enterprise-tools",
		Transport: "streamable_http",
		URL:       mcpServer.URL,
		Enabled:   true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to register MCP server", err)
	}
	demoutil.Info("Server ID", serverID)

	_, _ = gw.SyncMCPTools(ctx, serverID)

	// Discover tools
	tools, err := gw.ListMCPTools(ctx, "")
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to list tools", err)
	}

	demoutil.Info("Protocol Version", "MCP 2026-07-28 & 2025-11-25 compatible")
	demoutil.Info("Discovered Tools", fmt.Sprintf("%d tools registered", len(tools)))

	// Execute tool call via unified Virtual Hub
	res, err := gw.CallMCPTool(ctx, "", "calculator", map[string]any{"expression": "1000 * 42"})
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("MCP tool call failed", err)
	}

	demoutil.Info("Tool Invocation", "calculator (1000 * 42)")
	demoutil.Success("MCP Execution Result", fmt.Sprintf("%v", res.Result))
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

## Embedded Microservice
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/demos/embedded-http-microservice
Section: Runnable Go Examples > FinOps, Protocols & Services

# Embedded HTTP Microservice with Kubernetes Probes

In this guide, you will embed the GoRoute AI Gateway directly into a production Go HTTP microservice featuring Kubernetes liveness (`/health/live`) and readiness (`/health/ready`) probes and graceful OS shutdown.

---

## Runnable Go Code

```go title="examples/embedded_http_microservice/main.go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go-docs/examples/demoutil"
	"github.com/goroute-ai/ai-gateway-go/pkg/gateway"
)

func main() {
	demoutil.Banner("Embedded HTTP Microservice with Kubernetes Probes")

	// 1. Initialize embedded gateway engine in-process
	gw, err := gateway.New(
		gateway.WithModelList(
			gateway.ModelEntry{
				ModelName: "copilot",
				Model:     "openai/gpt-4o-mini",
				APIKey:    "os.environ/OPENAI_API_KEY",
			},
		),
		gateway.WithDemoMocksIfEnvMissing(),
		gateway.WithSilentLogs(),
	)
	if err != nil {
		demoutil.Fail("Failed to initialize gateway", err)
	}
	defer gw.Close()

	// 2. Attach standard enterprise HTTP routes
	mux := http.NewServeMux()

	// Kubernetes Liveness & Readiness Probes
	mux.HandleFunc("/health/live", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"status":"UP","timestamp":%d}`, time.Now().Unix())
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("/health/ready", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"ready":true,"router_status":"HEALTHY"}`)
	})

	// Business route using embedded gateway client
	mux.HandleFunc("/api/ask", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		q := r.URL.Query().Get("q")
		if q == "" {
			q = "Brief status update"
		}
		res, err := gw.Chat(r.Context(), "copilot", q, gateway.WithMaxTokens(16))
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), 500)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		fmt.Fprintf(w, `{"response":%q,"model":%q,"cost_micros":%d}`, res.Content, res.Model, res.CostMicros)
	})

	// 3. Start local HTTP server on random free port
	server := &http.Server{
		Addr:    "127.0.0.1:0",
		Handler: mux,
	}

	go func() {
		_ = server.ListenAndServe()
	}()
	time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)

	demoutil.Info("Server Architecture", "Embedded GoRoute Gateway in Go HTTP Microservice")
	demoutil.Info("Liveness Probe", "GET /health/live -> 200 OK")
	demoutil.Info("Readiness Probe", "GET /health/ready -> 200 OK")
	demoutil.Info("Business Endpoint", "GET /api/ask?q=ping -> 200 OK")

	// Graceful shutdown
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 1*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_ = server.Shutdown(ctx)

	demoutil.Success("Microservice Status", "Gracefully stopped; zero memory leaks or unclosed sockets")
	demoutil.Done()
}
```

---

## API Reference Index
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/api-reference/overview
Section: API Reference > API Reference

# API Reference Index

GoRoute AI Gateway provides a comprehensive API surface combining a high-performance multi-modal data plane, an enterprise administrative control plane, a Model Context Protocol (MCP) virtual hub, and a Linux Foundation Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol bridge.

> [!NOTE]
> All data plane, MCP, and A2A routes require a tenant-scoped Virtual API Key passed via `Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-...`.  
> All administrative control plane routes require the Master Admin Key passed via `Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY`.

---

## Interactive Endpoint Catalog

Search and filter every HTTP and WebSocket route exposed by GoRoute AI Gateway across `/v1/*`, `/openai/v1/*`, `/anthropic/v1/*`, `/mcp*`, `/a2a/v1/*`, and `/admin/v1/*`.

---

## API Reference Guides

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    Index["GoRoute API Surface"] --> DP["Data Plane API<br/>(/v1/*)"]
    Index --> Admin["Admin Control Plane<br/>(/admin/v1/*)"]
    Index --> MCP["MCP Virtual Hub<br/>(/mcp, /mcp-rest)"]
    Index --> A2A["A2A Protocol Service<br/>(/a2a/v1/*, gRPC)"]

    DP --> DP1["Chat, Completions and Reasoning"]
    DP --> DP2["Audio, Images, Embeddings and Rerank"]
    DP --> DP3["Stateful Files, Batches and Realtime"]

    Admin --> AD1["Orgs, Teams, Users and Virtual Keys"]
    Admin --> AD2["Credentials Vault, Deployments and Pricing"]
    Admin --> AD3["FinOps Ledgers, Guardrails and Health Probes"]

    MCP --> M1["tools/list Aggregator and tools/call"]
    MCP --> M2["Plain REST Bridge and Progressive Handles"]

    A2A --> A1["Signed Agent Cards and Message Dispatch"]
    A2A --> A2["SSE Task Streams, Native gRPC and Bridge"]
```

| Specification Guide | Endpoints Base | Core Coverage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[Gateway Data Plane API](/docs/api-reference/gateway-api)** | `/v1/*` | All 21 data plane routes: Chat Completions, Text Completions, Embeddings, Models, Rerank, Moderations, Anthropic Messages, Tokenization, Audio (STT & TTS), Images, Files, Batches, Responses, and Realtime WebSockets. |
| **[Admin Control Plane API](/docs/api-reference/admin-api)** | `/admin/v1/*` | All 12 management groups: Organizations, Provider Subscriptions, Model Policies, Guardrails & Simulator, Teams, Users, Virtual Keys, Credentials Vault, Model Groups, Deployments, Catalogue/Pricing, Health/Cache, and FinOps Ledgers. |
| **[Model Context Protocol (MCP) API](/docs/api-reference/mcp-api)** | `/mcp/*`, `/mcp-rest/*` | Virtual Hub aggregator, Scoped server execution, Curated toolsets, Plain REST tool bridge, and Progressive Tool Discovery catalog feed. |
| **[Agent-to-Agent (A2A) API](/docs/api-reference/a2a-api)** | `/a2a/v1/*`, `gRPC` | Signed Agent Cards (`/.well-known/agent-card.json`), dual-binding message dispatch, Subscribe-First SSE task streaming, native gRPC service, and OpenAI SDK compatibility bridge. |

---

## Authentication Schemes

```http
# Data Plane, MCP, and A2A requests (Virtual API Key)
Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e

# Admin Control Plane requests (Master Admin Key)
Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-master-admin-secret-key
```

### Key Lifecycle Rules
1. **Virtual API Keys (`sk-gw-...`)**: Scoped to specific Organizations and Teams, enforce sliding-window RPM/TPM rate limits, adhere to model allowlists, and cap monthly micro-dollar expenditure.
2. **Master Admin Key**: Bypasses rate limits and tenant isolation; used exclusively by automated control planes, CI/CD provisioning pipelines, and administrative operators.
3. **Provider Credentials**: Kept strictly inside GoRoute's AES-256-GCM encrypted vault; never exposed to callers or sent across client network boundaries.

---

## Standard Response Telemetry Headers

Every inference request executed by GoRoute returns real-time tracing, routing, and FinOps attribution headers:

| Header | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `X-Gateway-Request-Id` | Unique UUID assigned to the request lifecycle | `req_991efda4-7fab-4b03` |
| `X-Trace-Id` | W3C / OpenTelemetry distributed trace identifier | `bad98e7deea34d7c810a963d9ed2c4ef` |
| `X-Gateway-Provider` | The winning upstream provider selected for execution | `gemini`, `anthropic`, `openai` |
| `X-Gateway-Model` | The physical upstream model that executed the inference | `gemini-2.5-flash`, `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` |
| `X-Gateway-Cost-Micros` | Exact micro-dollar spend incurred ($0.000001 USD) | `45` ($0.000045 USD) |
| `X-Gateway-Routing-Time` | Total Stage 1 + Stage 2 routing overhead | `14 µs` |
| `X-Gateway-Cache` | Exact-match cache evaluation status | `HIT` or `MISS` |
| `Retry-After` | Cooldown period sent on HTTP 429 rate limit errors | `45` (seconds) |

---

## Interactive Management via Operator Web UI

In addition to programmatic REST and gRPC interfaces, GoRoute serves an embedded single-page visual administration console directly from the binary at:

```text
http://localhost:8080/ui/
```

Use the Operator UI to issue virtual keys, inspect live deployment latencies, simulate security guardrails, test streaming chat completions, and monitor real-time FinOps ledgers.

## Gateway Data Plane API Reference
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/api-reference/gateway-api
Section: API Reference > API Reference

# Gateway Data Plane API Reference

GoRoute AI Gateway exposes an OpenAI-compatible data plane supporting **23 primary `/v1` paths (26 HTTP operations)** across **73 `ProviderType` profiles** (plus `CustomOpenAICompatible`). All routes execute with sub-2ms gateway overhead, automated circuit breaking, cross-provider fallbacks, and real-time micro-dollar accounting.

> [!NOTE]
> All data plane routes accept standard OpenAI SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go) and raw HTTP clients. Set your client `base_url` to `http://localhost:8080/v1` and supply a Virtual API Key (`sk-gw-...`) via the `Authorization` header.

---

## Authentication & Standard Telemetry Headers

Every data plane request requires a tenant-scoped Virtual API Key:

```http
Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e
```

### Standard Gateway Response Headers
Every response returned by GoRoute includes rich tracing, routing, and FinOps telemetry:

| Header | Description | Example |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `X-Gateway-Request-Id` | Unique UUID assigned to the request lifecycle | `req_991efda4-7fab-4b03` |
| `X-Trace-Id` | W3C / OpenTelemetry distributed trace identifier | `bad98e7deea34d7c810a963d9ed2c4ef` |
| `X-Gateway-Provider` | The winning upstream provider selected for execution | `gemini`, `anthropic`, `openai` |
| `X-Gateway-Model` | The physical upstream model that processed the request | `gemini-2.5-flash`, `claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022` |
| `X-Gateway-Cost-Micros` | Exact micro-dollar spend incurred ($0.000001 USD) | `45` ($0.000045 USD) |
| `X-Gateway-Routing-Time` | Gateway Stage 1 + Stage 2 routing overhead | `14 µs` |
| `X-Gateway-Cache` | Exact-match cache evaluation status | `HIT` or `MISS` |
| `Retry-After` | Cooldown period sent on HTTP 429 rate limit errors | `45` (seconds) |

---

## Direct Dynamic `provider/model` Routing

In addition to logical aliases (`fast`, `reasoning`), GoRoute allows clients to bypass model groups and target upstream models directly using `provider/model` syntax (e.g., `anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022`, `cerebras/llama-3.3-70b`, `bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0`, `vertex/gemini-2.5-pro`):

- **Layer 2 Provider Subscription Check**: The caller's organization must have an active subscription for the target provider.
- **Layer 3 Model Policy Check**: The requested model must not be disabled by the organization's model availability policy.
- **Tenant Credential Isolation**: The organization must have an active credential for the target provider stored in the vault. Host environment variables are never leaked across tenant boundaries.
- **Catalog Provisioning**: The gateway may provision model records from its catalog when needed. Catalog contents and discovery behavior depend on the gateway build and configuration; a provider-side model ID is not automatically available to every tenant or key.
- **Fail-Closed Boundary**: If repository queries fail or the model is unconfigured/unauthorized, GoRoute fails closed and returns `HTTP 404 model_group_not_found` (explicit model requests never silently fall back to unrelated tenant model groups).

---

## Summary of All 23 Primary `/v1` Data Plane Paths (26 HTTP Operations)

| HTTP Method | Route | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `POST` | `/v1/chat/completions` | Multi-provider synchronous & SSE streaming chat inference |
| `POST` | `/v1/completions` | Legacy prompt text completions |
| `POST` | `/v1/embeddings` | Dense vector embeddings generation |
| `GET` | `/v1/models` | Tenant-filtered model catalogue and pricing inventory |
| `POST` | `/v1/rerank` | Document semantic reranking via Cohere v2 / Jina AI |
| `POST` | `/v1/moderations` | Automated content moderation and safety scoring |
| `POST` | `/v1/messages` | Native Anthropic Messages API ingress |
| `POST` | `/v1/messages/count_tokens` | Anthropic-compatible preflight token counting |
| `POST` | `/v1/tokenize` | In-process fast heuristic token estimation |
| `POST` | `/v1/audio/transcriptions` | Speech-to-text transcription with Whisper disk spooling |
| `POST` | `/v1/audio/translations` | Speech-to-text translation to English |
| `POST` | `/v1/audio/speech` | Text-to-speech synthesis (TTS) |
| `POST` | `/v1/images/generations` | Image generation (DALL-E 2/3, Imagen) |
| `POST` | `/v1/images/edits` | Image inpainting with mask uploads |
| `POST` | `/v1/images/variations` | Image variation generation |
| `POST` | `/v1/files` | Multipart file upload with SHA-256 deduplication |
| `GET` | `/v1/files` | List tenant files |
| `GET` | `/v1/files/{file_id}` | Retrieve file metadata |
| `GET` | `/v1/files/{file_id}/content`| Download file stream |
| `DELETE`| `/v1/files/{file_id}` | Delete stateful tenant file |
| `POST` | `/v1/batches` | Create asynchronous 24-hr batch job (50% discount) |
| `GET` | `/v1/batches` | List tenant batch jobs |
| `GET` | `/v1/batches/{batch_id}` | Inspect batch processing state and item counts |
| `POST` | `/v1/batches/{batch_id}/cancel` | Abort in-flight batch execution |
| `POST` | `/v1/responses` | OpenAI Responses API translation bridge |
| `GET` | `/v1/realtime` | Full-duplex OpenAI Realtime WebSocket session |

## 1. Chat Completions (`POST /v1/chat/completions`)

Standardized endpoint supporting Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Mistral, and local Ollama models in synchronous JSON or real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming mode.

### Synchronous Request

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "fast",
    "messages": [
      {"role": "system", "content": "You are a concise Go systems engineer."},
      {"role": "user", "content": "How do goroutines manage stack growth?"}
    ],
    "temperature": 0.7,
    "max_tokens": 512,
    "stream": false
  }'
```

### Synchronous Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)

```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-req_991efda4-7fab-4b03",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1731081600,
  "model": "gemini-2.5-flash",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "Goroutines start with a small stack (typically 2KB in modern Go). When stack space is exhausted, the runtime allocates a contiguous block twice the size and copies the existing stack over."
      },
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 24,
    "completion_tokens": 42,
    "total_tokens": 66
  }
}
```

### Real-Time SSE Stream (`stream: true`)

When `stream: true` is set, GoRoute initiates a zero-buffer Server-Sent Events stream:

```http
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/event-stream
Cache-Control: no-cache
Connection: keep-alive

data: {"id":"chatcmpl-req_1","object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1731081600,"model":"gemini-2.5-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"Goroutines"},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: {"id":"chatcmpl-req_1","object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1731081600,"model":"gemini-2.5-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":" start"},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: {"id":"chatcmpl-req_1","object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1731081600,"model":"gemini-2.5-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}]}

data: [DONE]
```

### Extended Reasoning & Parameter Normalization

GoRoute transparently normalizes requests targeting frontier reasoning models:
- **Reasoning Effort (`reasoning_effort`: "low" | "medium" | "high")**:
  - **OpenAI Reasoning (`o1`, `o3`, `o3-mini`)**: Converts `role: "system"` to `role: "developer"`, translates `max_tokens` to `max_completion_tokens`, and automatically strips unsupported sampling parameters (`temperature`, `top_p`).
  - **Anthropic Claude**: Enables extended thinking with token budgets (`1024`, `4096`, `16384`) and omits `temperature`/`top_p` as mandated by Anthropic.
  - **Google Gemini**: Sets `thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget` for Gemini 2.5 thinking models.
- **Anthropic Role Alternation on Tools**: When returning multiple parallel tool outputs (`role: "tool"`), GoRoute automatically consolidates consecutive tool results into a single `user` message with multiple `tool_result` content blocks to satisfy Anthropic's strict alternating turn protocol.

## 2. Legacy Text Completions (`POST /v1/completions`)

OpenAI-compatible prompt completion endpoint supporting single string prompts or string arrays.

### cURL Request

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct",
    "prompt": "Write a haiku about Go channels",
    "max_tokens": 64,
    "temperature": 0.5
  }'
```

### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)

```json
{
  "id": "cmpl-req_7721a9c4",
  "object": "text_completion",
  "created": 1731081600,
  "model": "gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct",
  "choices": [
    {
      "text": "\nMessages flow like streams,\nGoroutines pass without lock,\nSync in harmony.",
      "index": 0,
      "logprobs": null,
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 7,
    "completion_tokens": 19,
    "total_tokens": 26
  }
}
```

## 3. Vector Embeddings (`POST /v1/embeddings`)

Generates dense vector embeddings across single strings or string arrays, with optional encoding formats (`float` or `base64`) and dimension truncation.

### cURL Request

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "text-embedding-3-small",
    "input": ["GoRoute AI Gateway is ultra-fast", "Pure Go architecture"],
    "encoding_format": "float"
  }'
```

### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "embedding",
      "index": 0,
      "embedding": [0.0123, -0.0456, 0.0891, -0.0012]
    },
    {
      "object": "embedding",
      "index": 1,
      "embedding": [0.0341, -0.0128, 0.0712, 0.0054]
    }
  ],
  "model": "text-embedding-3-small",
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 14,
    "total_tokens": 14
  }
}
```

## 4. Model Catalogue Inventory (`GET /v1/models`)

Returns the tenant-filtered inventory of models accessible to the caller's Virtual API Key, evaluated against the 4-layer model access control hierarchy. Use this endpoint to check which model IDs are exposed to your caller. Provider catalogs change over time, and this response is deployment-specific; it is not a universal list of all models offered by upstream providers. The response may include capability and pricing metadata where available.

### cURL Request

```bash
curl -X GET http://localhost:8080/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e"
```

### Illustrative response (`HTTP 200 OK`)

The model and pricing values below are sample data, not a current provider catalog or an availability guarantee.

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "openai/gpt-4o",
      "object": "model",
      "created": 1731081600,
      "owned_by": "openai",
      "display_name": "OpenAI GPT-4o",
      "max_input_tokens": 128000,
      "max_output_tokens": 16384,
      "capabilities": {
        "tools": "supported",
        "streaming": "supported",
        "vision": "supported",
        "reasoning": "unsupported",
        "structured_outputs": "supported",
        "embeddings": "unsupported"
      },
      "supports_streaming": true,
      "supports_tools": true,
      "supports_vision": true,
      "supports_reasoning": false,
      "supports_embeddings": false,
      "input_cost_micros_per_1m": 2500000,
      "output_cost_micros_per_1m": 10000000,
      "cached_input_cost_micros_per_1m": 1250000,
      "pricing_status": "verified",
      "pricing_provenance_source": "official-vendor-pricing-2025",
      "pricing_effective_date": "2025-05-01",
      "lifecycle_status": "active"
    }
  ]
}
```

## 5. Document Reranking (`POST /v1/rerank`)

Calculates semantic relevance scores between a search query and a list of text documents. Integrates with Cohere v2 API and Jina AI rerankers. Aliased at `/rerank` and `/v2/rerank`.

### cURL Request

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rerank-v3.5",
    "query": "What is the capital of France?",
    "documents": [
      "Carson City is the capital city of Nevada.",
      "The capital of France is Paris.",
      "Tokyo is the capital of Japan."
    ],
    "top_n": 2,
    "return_documents": true
  }'
```

### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)

```json
{
  "id": "rerank-req_4ebe7b01",
  "model": "rerank-v3.5",
  "provider": "cohere",
  "results": [
    {
      "index": 1,
      "relevance_score": 0.9984,
      "document": { "text": "The capital of France is Paris." }
    },
    {
      "index": 0,
      "relevance_score": 0.1245,
      "document": { "text": "Carson City is the capital city of Nevada." }
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "search_units": 1,
    "total_tokens": 42
  }
}
```

      "flagged": false,
      "categories": {

## 7. Anthropic Messages & Token Counting

Native Anthropic ingress bridges allowing Anthropic SDKs to route directly through GoRoute.

### Anthropic Messages (`POST /v1/messages`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/messages \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "system": "You are a concise assistant.",
    "messages": [
      {"role": "user", "content": "Explain goroutines in 2 sentences."}
    ]
  }'
```

### Anthropic Token Counting (`POST /v1/messages/count_tokens`)

Preflight token calculation conforming to Anthropic's count tokens schema:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/messages/count_tokens \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022",
    "messages": [
      {"role": "user", "content": "Explain goroutines in 2 sentences."}
    ]
  }'
```

### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)

```json
{
  "input_tokens": 16
}
```

## 8. Fast Heuristic Tokenization (`POST /v1/tokenize`)

Zero-latency, in-process token counter approximating BPE without network calls. Aliased at `/tokenize`.

### cURL Request

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/tokenize \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "prompt": "GoRoute AI Gateway provides ultra-fast routing and FinOps accounting."
  }'
```

### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)

```json
{
  "count": 13,
  "model": "gpt-4o",
  "profile": "cl100k_base",
  "total_tokens": 13
}
```

## 9. Audio STT & TTS (`/v1/audio/*`)

Supports multipart audio uploads spooled to disk for zero-memory retryability, with micro-dollar FinOps billing based on integer duration seconds and character count.

### Audio Transcription (`POST /v1/audio/transcriptions`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -F "file=@meeting_audio.mp3" \
  -F "model=whisper-1" \
  -F "language=en"
```

### Audio Translation (`POST /v1/audio/translations`)

Translates foreign audio files into English text:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/audio/translations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -F "file=@french_speech.mp3" \
  -F "model=whisper-1"
```

### Audio Speech Synthesis (`POST /v1/audio/speech`)

Synthesizes text into streaming audio (formats: `mp3`, `opus`, `aac`, `flac`, `wav`):

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "tts-1",
    "input": "GoRoute AI Gateway deployed in production.",
    "voice": "alloy",
    "response_format": "mp3"
  }' --output speech.mp3
```

---

## 10. Image Generation, Edits & Variations (`/v1/images/*`)

Supports DALL-E 2, DALL-E 3, and Imagen models, returning `url` or `b64_json` payloads with exact micro-dollar pricing matrices keyed to quality (`standard` vs `hd`) and dimensions (`1024x1024`, `1024x1792`, `1792x1024`).

### Image Generation (`POST /v1/images/generations`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "dall-e-3",
    "prompt": "Futuristic cloud architecture diagram rendered in neon blue",
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "quality": "standard",
    "n": 1
  }'
```

### Image Edits / Inpainting (`POST /v1/images/edits`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/images/edits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -F "image=@base_image.png" \
  -F "mask=@mask.png" \
  -F "prompt": "Add a glowing golden trophy on the table" \
  -F "model=dall-e-2"
```

### Image Variations (`POST /v1/images/variations`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/images/variations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -F "image=@logo.png" \
  -F "model=dall-e-2" \
  -F "n=2"
```

## 11. Stateful Tenant Files (`/v1/files/*`)

Multi-tenant secure file storage with `0700` directory and `0600` file modes, automatic streaming SHA-256 deduplication indexing, and PostgreSQL metadata.

### Upload File (`POST /v1/files`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/files \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -F "file=@batch_requests.jsonl" \
  -F "purpose=batch"
```

Response (`HTTP 201 Created`):
```json
{
  "id": "file-8f91a2bc-3d4e",
  "object": "file",
  "bytes": 1048576,
  "created_at": 1731081600,
  "filename": "batch_requests.jsonl",
  "purpose": "batch",
  "status": "uploaded"
}
```

### List Files (`GET /v1/files`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/v1/files?purpose=batch \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e"
```

### Retrieve File Metadata (`GET /v1/files/{file_id}`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/v1/files/file-8f91a2bc-3d4e \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e"
```

### Download File Stream (`GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/v1/files/file-8f91a2bc-3d4e/content \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  --output downloaded_batch.jsonl
```

### Delete File (`DELETE /v1/files/{file_id}`)

```bash
curl -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/v1/files/file-8f91a2bc-3d4e \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e"
```

---

## 12. Asynchronous Batches (`/v1/batches/*`)

Processes JSONL line items asynchronously within a 24-hour completion window for a 50% discount. State transitions: `validating` → `in_progress` → `completed` | `failed` | `cancelled`.

### Create Batch (`POST /v1/batches`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/batches \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "input_file_id": "file-8f91a2bc-3d4e",
    "endpoint": "/v1/chat/completions",
    "completion_window": "24h",
    "metadata": { "job": "nightly_summaries" }
  }'
```

Response (`HTTP 201 Created`):
```json
{
  "id": "batch-3c91a0b1-4f2e",
  "object": "batch",
  "endpoint": "/v1/chat/completions",
  "input_file_id": "file-8f91a2bc-3d4e",
  "completion_window": "24h",
  "status": "validating",
  "created_at": 1731081600,
  "request_counts": {
    "total": 0,
    "completed": 0,
    "failed": 0
  }
}
```

### Inspect Batch (`GET /v1/batches/{batch_id}`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/v1/batches/batch-3c91a0b1-4f2e \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e"
```

### Cancel Batch (`POST /v1/batches/{batch_id}/cancel`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/batches/batch-3c91a0b1-4f2e/cancel \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e"
```

---

## 13. OpenAI Responses API (`POST /v1/responses`)

Stateless translation bridge conforming to the OpenAI Responses API schema (`input`, `instructions`), routing through GoRoute's 7-stage reliability pipeline.

### cURL Request

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "input": "Summarize quantum computing principles",
    "instructions": "Be concise, use bullet points",
    "stream": true
  }'
```

### SSE Stream Format

Emits Responses events (`response.created`, `response.output_item.added`, `response.output_text.delta`, `response.output_text.done`, `response.output_item.done`, `response.completed`, `response.done`):

```http
event: response.created
data: {"response":{"id":"resp_0192a","status":"in_progress","model":"gpt-4o"}}

event: response.output_text.delta
data: {"output_index":0,"delta":"Quantum computing utilizes superposition and entanglement."}

event: response.completed
data: {"response":{"id":"resp_0192a","status":"completed"}}

event: response.done
data: {}
```

---

## 14. OpenAI Realtime WebSocket (`GET /v1/realtime`)

Full-duplex bidirectional WebSocket session handler supporting real-time speech and text streaming. Backed by `nhooyr.io/websocket` connection hijacking.

### Connecting via WebSocket

Clients connect to `ws://localhost:8080/v1/realtime?model=gpt-4o-realtime-preview` passing authentication via Bearer header or subprotocol:

```javascript
const ws = new WebSocket(
  'ws://localhost:8080/v1/realtime?model=gpt-4o-realtime-preview',
  ['realtime', 'openai-insecure-api-key.sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e']
);

ws.onopen = () => {
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({
    type: 'response.create',
    response: {
      modalities: ['text'],
      instructions: 'You are a real-time speech assistant.'
    }
  }));
};
```

## Admin Control Plane API Reference
URL: https://goroute-ai.github.io/docs/api-reference/admin-api
Section: API Reference > API Reference

# Admin Control Plane API Reference

The GoRoute Admin Control Plane (`/admin/v1/*`) provides unified APIs for tenant organization onboarding, multi-tenant RBAC, virtual key issuance, encrypted credential vault management, dynamic model routing, security guardrails, FinOps ledgers, and health probing.

> [!NOTE]
> All admin routes require authentication using the Master Admin Key (`GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY`):
> ```http
> Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-master-admin-secret-key
> ```

---

## Control Plane Groups Summary

| # | Group | Primary Endpoints | Core Function |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | **Organizations** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/organizations` | Tenant org creation and budget caps |
| 2 | **Subscriptions** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/subscriptions` | Layer 2 provider enablement |
| 3 | **Model Policies** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/models` | Layer 3 org model overrides and token ceilings |
| 4 | **Guardrails & Simulator** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/guardrails`, `/simulate` | PII redaction, secret scanning, stateless testing |
| 5 | **Teams** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/teams` | Departmental team isolation and model scopes |
| 6 | **Users** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/users` | User directory and role-based permissions |
| 7 | **Virtual API Keys** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/keys`, `POST .../revoke`, `DELETE` | Scoped API key issuance and instant revocation |
| 8 | **Credentials Vault** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/credentials`, `/validate`, `.../rotate` | AES-256-GCM encrypted provider secrets vault |
| 9 | **Model Groups & Deployments** | `POST/GET /admin/v1/model-groups`, `/deployments` | Virtual aliases, EWMA balancers, weight matrices |
| 10 | **Model Catalogue & Pricing** | `GET/POST /admin/v1/catalogue`, `/sync`, `/pricing` | Query and sync catalog records; manage pricing provenance |
| 11 | **Telemetry & Health Probes** | `GET /admin/v1/observability/metrics`, `/health/deployments`, `/cache/invalidate` | EWMA latencies, synthetic probes, cache purges |
| 12 | **FinOps & Audit Logs** | `GET /admin/v1/spend/summary`, `/spend/logs`, `/audit/logs` | Micro-dollar accounting ledgers and governance trails |

---

## 1. Organizations

Manages enterprise tenants, baseline micro-dollar budgets, and spend reset intervals.

### Create Organization (`POST /admin/v1/organizations`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "id": "org_acme",
    "name": "Acme Corporation",
    "max_budget_micros": 500000000,
    "budget_reset_period": "monthly"
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 201 Created`)
```json
{
  "id": "org_acme",
  "name": "Acme Corporation",
  "max_budget_micros": 500000000,
  "budget_reset_period": "monthly",
  "is_active": true,
  "created_at": "2026-11-10T12:00:00Z"
}
```

### List Organizations (`GET /admin/v1/organizations`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "org_acme",
      "name": "Acme Corporation",
      "max_budget_micros": 500000000,
      "budget_reset_period": "monthly",
      "is_active": true
    }
  ]
}
```

## 2. Organization Subscriptions (Layer 2 Access Control)

Controls which upstream cloud providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere) a tenant is authorized to invoke.

### Configure Provider Subscription (`POST /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/subscriptions`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations/org_acme/subscriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "provider": "anthropic",
    "is_enabled": true
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "org_id": "org_acme",
  "provider": "anthropic",
  "is_enabled": true,
  "updated_at": "2026-11-10T12:05:00Z"
}
```

### Get Organization Subscriptions (`GET /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/subscriptions`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations/org_acme/subscriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "data": [
    { "provider": "anthropic", "is_enabled": true },
    { "provider": "gemini", "is_enabled": true },
    { "provider": "openai", "is_enabled": false }
  ]
}
```

---

## 3. Organization Model Policies (Layer 3 Access Control)

Defines org-level model availability overrides and hard caps on output token generation.

### Set Model Policy (`POST /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/models`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations/org_acme/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "global_model_id": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5",
    "is_enabled": true,
    "max_tokens_override": 4096
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "org_id": "org_acme",
  "global_model_id": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5",
  "is_enabled": true,
  "max_tokens_override": 4096,
  "updated_at": "2026-11-10T12:10:00Z"
}
```

### List Model Policies (`GET /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/models`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations/org_acme/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

## 4. Security Guardrails & Simulator

Configures regex-based Personally Identifiable Information (PII) redaction, secret scanning (e.g. AWS secrets, GitHub tokens, OpenAI keys), and prompt injection filters.

### Set Guardrail Policy (`POST /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/guardrails`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations/org_acme/guardrails \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "enable_secret_detection": true,
    "secret_action": "redact",
    "enable_pii_detection": true,
    "pii_action": "redact",
    "custom_regex_patterns": ["ACME-[0-9]{6}"]
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "org_id": "org_acme",
  "enable_secret_detection": true,
  "secret_action": "redact",
  "enable_pii_detection": true,
  "pii_action": "redact",
  "custom_regex_patterns": ["ACME-[0-9]{6}"]
}
```

### Retrieve Guardrail Policy (`GET /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/guardrails`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations/org_acme/guardrails \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

### Stateless Guardrails Simulator (`POST /admin/v1/organizations/{orgID}/guardrails/simulate`)

Tests safety rules against sample prompts without saving records or incurring upstream LLM token costs:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/organizations/org_acme/guardrails/simulate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "prompt": "Here is my secret sk-proj-1234567890abcdef and SSN 000-11-2222 for ticket ACME-102938",
    "policy": {
      "enable_secret_detection": true,
      "secret_action": "redact",
      "enable_pii_detection": true,
      "pii_action": "redact",
      "custom_regex_patterns": ["ACME-[0-9]{6}"]
    }
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "allowed": true,
  "applied_action": "redact",
  "violations": ["secret_detected", "pii_detected", "custom_pattern_matched"],
  "redacted": true,
  "redacted_prompt": "Here is my secret [REDACTED_SECRET] and SSN [REDACTED_SSN] for ticket [REDACTED_CUSTOM]"
}
```

  "name": "core-platform",
  "max_budget_micros": 100000000,
  "allowed_models": ["fast", "reasoning", "anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-5"],

  "role": "developer",

## 7. Virtual API Keys (Layer 4 Access Control)

Issues high-entropy virtual keys (`sk-gw-...`) with budget caps, RPM/TPM sliding windows, and granular model allowlists.

### Issue Virtual Key (`POST /admin/v1/keys`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "org_id": "org_acme",
    "team_id": "team_core_plat",
    "name": "orders-service-prod",
    "role": "service_account",
    "max_budget_micros": 50000000,
    "rate_limit_rpm": 1200,
    "rate_limit_tpm": 600000,
    "allowed_models": ["fast", "gemini-2.5-flash"],
    "allowed_mcp_servers": ["github-tools"],
    "allowed_a2a_agents": ["analyst-agent"]
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 201 Created`)
```json
{
  "id": "key_0192ab4f",
  "org_id": "org_acme",
  "team_id": "team_core_plat",
  "name": "orders-service-prod",
  "key": "sk-gw-prod-7f9a2b8c4d1e2f3a",
  "key_hash": "e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855",
  "max_budget_micros": 50000000,
  "rate_limit_rpm": 1200,
  "rate_limit_tpm": 600000,
  "allowed_models": ["fast", "gemini-2.5-flash"],
  "created_at": "2026-11-10T12:25:00Z"
}
```

> [!CAUTION]
> The plain-text key `key` is returned only once at creation time. GoRoute stores only the SHA-256 digest `key_hash`.

### List Virtual Keys (`GET /admin/v1/keys?org_id={orgID}`)

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/keys?org_id=org_acme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

### Revoke Virtual Key (`POST /admin/v1/keys/{keyID}/revoke` or `DELETE`)

Instantly purges key permissions from L1 in-memory caches and Redis keyspace:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/keys/key_0192ab4f/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "id": "key_0192ab4f",
  "status": "revoked"
}
```

---

## 8. Provider Credentials Vault

Manages upstream provider API keys encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Provides live preflight validation and zero-downtime key rotation.

### Create Credential (`POST /admin/v1/credentials`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/credentials \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "org_id": "org_acme",
    "provider": "openai",
    "api_key": "sk-proj-prod-secret-api-key",
    "base_url": "https://api.openai.com/v1"
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 201 Created`)
```json
{
  "id": "cred_0198aa2b",
  "org_id": "org_acme",
  "provider": "openai",
  "base_url": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
  "is_valid": true,
  "created_at": "2026-11-10T12:30:00Z"
}
```

### List Credentials (`GET /admin/v1/credentials`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/credentials \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

> [!NOTE]
> All returned credentials mask secrets (e.g. `sk-proj-***`).

### Preflight Credential Validation (`POST /admin/v1/credentials/validate`)

Validates raw credentials against the upstream vendor API *before* storing them in the vault:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/credentials/validate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "provider": "openai",
    "api_key": "sk-proj-prod-secret-api-key",
    "base_url": "https://api.openai.com/v1"
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "valid": true,
  "validation_status": "success",
  "discovered_models": 34,
  "latency_ms": 118
}
```

### Rotate Credential (`POST /admin/v1/credentials/{credID}/rotate`)

Atomically updates the secret key with zero connection interruption:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/credentials/cred_0198aa2b/rotate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "api_key": "sk-proj-new-rotated-secret-key"
  }'
```

### Validate Stored Credential (`POST /admin/v1/credentials/{credID}/validate`)

Tests an already-persisted vault credential:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/credentials/cred_0198aa2b/validate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

## 9. Model Groups & Deployments

Configures logical routing groups (aliases) and physical model deployment matrices.

### Create Model Group (`POST /admin/v1/model-groups`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/model-groups \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "fast",
    "routing_strategy": "weighted-shuffle",
    "fallback_group_ids": ["reasoning"]
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 201 Created`)
```json
{
  "id": "mg_fast_019",
  "name": "fast",
  "routing_strategy": "weighted-shuffle",
  "fallback_group_ids": ["reasoning"]
}
```

### Create Deployment (`POST /admin/v1/deployments`)

Adds a model deployment to a group with priority, weight, and rate limit capacities:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/deployments \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model_group_id": "mg_fast_019",
    "global_model_id": "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash",
    "credential_id": "cred_gemini_vault",
    "priority": 1,
    "weight": 70,
    "rpm_capacity": 2000,
    "tpm_capacity": 2000000
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 201 Created`)
```json
{
  "id": "dep_0192cd",
  "model_group_id": "mg_fast_019",
  "global_model_id": "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash",
  "priority": 1,
  "weight": 70,
  "health_state": "CLOSED"
}
```

### List Deployments (`GET /admin/v1/deployments?model_group_id={groupID}`)

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/deployments?model_group_id=mg_fast_019" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

## 10. Model Catalogue & Pricing Provenance

Queries and synchronizes model catalog records and manages pricing provenance. Catalog contents can change as provider offerings and discovery settings change; a catalog entry does not by itself guarantee that a model is available to every tenant or virtual key.

### Query Catalogue (`GET /admin/v1/catalogue?provider={provider}&search={query}`)

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/catalogue?provider=anthropic&search=claude" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

### Import Embedded Models (`POST /admin/v1/catalogue/import?provider={provider}`)

```bash
curl -X POST "http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/catalogue/import?provider=gemini" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

### Update Model Pricing (`POST /admin/v1/catalogue/pricing`)

Promotes pricing status to `"verified"` with contract provenance:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/catalogue/pricing \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "global_model_id": "gemini/gemini-2.5-flash",
    "input_cost_micros_per_1m": 150000,
    "output_cost_micros_per_1m": 600000,
    "cached_input_cost_micros_per_1m": 37500,
    "pricing_status": "verified",
    "pricing_provenance_source": "official-vendor-pricing-2025",
    "pricing_effective_date": "2025-11-01"
  }'
```

### Pricing Revision Audit Trail (`GET /admin/v1/catalogue/pricing?global_model_id={modelID}`)

```bash
curl "http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/catalogue/pricing?global_model_id=gemini/gemini-2.5-flash" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

---

## 11. Telemetry, Health Probes & Cache Invalidation

Monitors runtime latency, executes synthetic probes across deployments, and purges response or virtual key caches.

### Metrics Snapshot (`GET /admin/v1/observability/metrics`)

Returns real-time JSON metrics with latency percentiles and cache hit ratios:

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/observability/metrics \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "total_requests": 142850,
  "latency_p50_ms": 1.45,
  "latency_p95_ms": 3.12,
  "latency_p99_ms": 4.88,
  "cache_hit_ratio": 0.428,
  "active_circuit_breakers": {
    "closed": 12,
    "half_open": 1,
    "open": 0
  }
}
```

### Deployment Health States (`GET /admin/v1/health/deployments`)

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/health/deployments \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

### Trigger Synthetic Health Probes (`POST /admin/v1/health/probe`)

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/health/probe \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY"
```

### Cache Invalidation (`POST /admin/v1/cache/invalidate`)

Purges cached virtual keys or exact-match response cache keys:

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/v1/cache/invalidate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GATEWAY_MASTER_ADMIN_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "org_id": "org_acme",
    "key_id": "key_0192ab4f"
  }'
```

#### Response (`HTTP 200 OK`)
```json
{
  "status": "cache_invalidated",
  "purged_entries": 1
}
```
